organisation.departmentsBody: Departments group agents so a ticket can be routed to a team rather than a person.

serviceLevels.holidaysHint: One date per line, as YYYY-MM-DD.
serviceLevels.atRiskHint: A ticket is flagged before it breaches, at this share of its target.
serviceLevels.notYetEnforced: These targets are recorded now and start being enforced in a later story.

email.replayHint: Feeds the message back through, as if it had just arrived.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.immutabilityNote: Entries are written once and never changed or removed — not by an administrator, not through this screen, and not through the API. That is what makes the log worth reading after an incident.

filters.dateNote: Dates are inclusive and read in UTC.

forbidden.body: Reading what every colleague has done is limited to administrators.
